Messages.Author: sinaath
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Is attempting a very moment of declaration of strike, or does it spread till
strike resolution?
I mean, 2 players declaring their strikes (let say both plays Burst of
Sunlight) and 3rd player,
who wants toplay Rotschreck in favour of acting minion (A).
How timing should look like:

ver 1.
A: declares strike BoS
C: plays Rotschreck (B doesnt waste his BoS)

ver 2.
A: declares BoS
C: waits..
B: declares BoS
C: plays Rotschreck

pretty same thing may came if one want to wait for damage prevention.
IMO ver 1. is correct (that's how we ruled it last time).

sinaath

--
Rötschreck [Jyhad:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PG, BH:PTr2]
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. <Frenzy.>
Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict
aggravated damage on him or her,
whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This
vampire is tapped and sent to torpor.
This vampire does not untap as normal. During this vampire's next untap
phase, burn this card.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"sinaath" <sin...@kill.this.gmail.com> wrote in message
news:cn2bj7$ffd$1...@news2.ipartners.pl...

> Hello,
>
> Is attempting a very moment of declaration of strike, or does it spread
till
> strike resolution?

It is the choose strike phase beginning with the announcement of that
strike and ending with the conclusion of the choose strike phase (before
the strike resolution phase(s)).

> I mean, 2 players declaring their strikes (let say both plays Burst of
> Sunlight) and 3rd player,
> who wants toplay Rotschreck in favour of acting minion (A).
> How timing should look like:
>
> ver 1.
> A: declares strike BoS
> C: plays Rotschreck (B doesnt waste his BoS)

Legal.

> ver 2.
> A: declares BoS
> C: waits..
> B: declares BoS
> C: plays Rotschreck

Legal.

> pretty same thing may came if one want to wait for damage prevention.
